name: rings
author: coldsoldr
description: Mutable Instruments Rings as a synth engine: a physical-modelling resonator with six models (modal, sympathetic strings, inharmonic string, FM voice, quantized sympathetic strings, string and reverb) and a polyphony of 1, 2, 4 or all six voices.
credits: Port of Mutable Instruments Rings by Émilie Gillet (MIT)
